morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic exports plunge due to Iran conflict amid rising propane and infrastructure pressures.
what_changed: Ceramic exports dropped by Rs 3,589 crore over six months due to the Iran war.
Industrial propane gas prices rose by Rs 3 to reach Rs 104 per kg.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore.
stress_signals: Iran war impacts led to a massive Rs 3,589 crore drop in ceramic exports [19f71f3185bc].
Escalating propane prices (up by Rs 3 to Rs 104/kg) cloud tile makers' recovery [3d9aa30057b8, 9e8c549b7c05].
Overall export outlook remains weak despite shipments to the Gulf resuming [c2b4a2f5422a].
improvement_signals: Propane usage has resumed in the Morbi ceramic cluster [3d9aa30057b8].
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed [c2b4a2f5422a].
Kajaria Ceramics invested ₹1.21 crore in a solar energy stake [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor working capital utilization and debt servicing for export-oriented units facing revenue contractions.
Track further movements in industrial propane and gas input prices impacting operating margins.
Assess resolution of local infrastructure, power, and water representations submitted to the district minister.

surat.headline: Surat cluster shows mixed trends with severe textile payment stress offset by festive diamond demand.
what_changed: SGCCI signed two MoUs in Morocco to boost Surat textile exports [472a28abf217].
Sayan zone weavers planned a collective vacation cutting production by 60 crore meters over 15 days [297b184838d2].
Textile PLI scheme turnover threshold was halved and extended to FY 2033-34 [c7ee55f3effe].
stress_signals: Surat textile payment dues exceeded 200 days leading to protests ahead of Diwali [774ba602b06e].
Surat Mercantile Association warned of a severe payment crisis threatening small traders [e0787797133b].
Ahmedabad traders were arrested for defrauding Surat merchants of over Rs 22 lakh [f699b1f05b5e].
improvement_signals: Surat lab-grown diamond demand rose ahead of Diwali with workers offered a 10% bonus [751cd1661531].
Global demand prompted diamond cutting and polishing factories to stay open until Dhanteras [e533595d0815].
what_to_watch: Monitor recovery of outstanding textile payment dues exceeding 200 days across small trading accounts [774ba602b06e].
Track capacity utilization post-collective vacation in the Sayan weaving zone [297b184838d2].
Observe post-Diwali demand sustainability in the lab-grown and natural diamond segments [751cd1661531, e533595d0815].
